externalResources.title: Official Wiki taxonomy
externalResources.titleZh: 官方 Wiki 分类骨架
externalResources.description: Use the official Wiki to browse entity families and historical field pages such as Nina's Ranch, Farmer's Land, Barn, Coop, Water Tower, Silo, Mammal Animals, Oviparous Animals and Breeding System Quality. Building pages expose useful field names like requirements, capacity, troughs, kit slots and coverage, while shop pages expose old location and hours; their 2023/2024/Alpha values are not a 0.8.10.858 table and still need current-build verification.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 用官方 Wiki 浏览实体分类，也可查看 Nina's Ranch、Farmer's Land、Barn、Coop、Water Tower、Silo、Mammal Animals、Oviparous Animals 和 Breeding System Quality 等历史字段页。建筑页能发现材料、容量、食槽、组件槽和覆盖范围等字段，商店页能发现旧位置与营业时间；其中的 2023/2024/Alpha 数值不是 0.8.10.858 数据表，仍需当前版本核对。

externalResources.title: Official Wiki Linux and Steam Deck how-to
externalResources.titleZh: 官方 Wiki Linux 与 Steam Deck 说明
externalResources.description: The official Wiki has a dedicated Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck how-to that documents native-version launch behavior and an old cache-refresh workaround. It is useful for finding platform-support questions, but the page still cites Alpha 0.6.28.171 and does not prove a current 0.8.10.858 fix or gameplay rule.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 官方 Wiki 有专门的 Linux/SteamOS/Steam Deck 说明，记录原生版本启动行为和一个旧的缓存刷新 workaround。它适合发现平台支持问题，但页面仍引用 Alpha 0.6.28.171，不能证明 0.8.10.858 的当前修复或任何玩法规则。

externalResources.title: Official Steam news
externalResources.titleZh: Steam 官方新闻
externalResources.description: Check this feed for patch notes and developer announcements before trusting a number or troubleshooting step.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在确认数字或排查步骤前，先到这里查看补丁说明和开发者公告。

externalResources.title: 0.8.10.858 solo mode and handheld behavior
externalResources.titleZh: 0.8.10.858 单人模式与掌机行为
externalResources.description: The official 0.8.10.858 announcement says new games and loaded saves ask whether to PLAY SOLO or OPEN TO FRIENDS. PLAY SOLO does not require an internet connection and is designed to resume safely after a handheld sleeps; OPEN TO FRIENDS requires a stable connection for guests. This is a session-mode rule, not proof that every save or network problem is fixed.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 官方 0.8.10.858 公告说明：新游戏和读档时会让玩家选择 PLAY SOLO 或 OPEN TO FRIENDS。PLAY SOLO 不需要联网，掌机睡眠后可更安全地恢复；OPEN TO FRIENDS 需要稳定网络才能让好友加入。这是会话模式规则，不代表所有存档或网络问题都已修复。

externalResources.title: NPC gifting works; Dating v2 is not implemented
externalResources.titleZh: NPC 可以送礼；Dating v2 尚未实装
externalResources.description: In Steam moderator answers, players can currently build relationships by equipping a gift and presenting it to an NPC. Preferences differ by NPC, so test a few items and read the reaction; only the first gift of the day changes the relationship. Any NPC can be befriended, but not every NPC is romanceable; Dating v2 is planned rather than implemented. These answers confirm the interaction and daily limit, not a universal favorite-item or reward table.
externalResources.descriptionZh: Steam 版主答复确认：当前可以把礼物装备在手上并交给 NPC 来积累关系。每个 NPC 的喜好不同，应试送几种物品并观察反应；每天只有第一份礼物会改变关系。所有 NPC 都可以先建立关系，但不是每个 NPC 都能恋爱；Dating v2 仍是计划内容。这些答复确认了操作和每日限制，不等于通用喜好表或奖励表。

sourceLinks.label: Daily gift limit and NPC-specific preferences
sourceLinks.labelZh: 每日送礼限制与 NPC 个体喜好

externalResources.title: Steam player feedback radar
externalResources.titleZh: Steam 玩家反馈雷达
externalResources.description: The discussion index showed 273 active topics on 2026-09-12. Recent titles include relationship and romance questions, white-looking fresh feed, a strawberry field disappearing after sleep, cars left near City Hall, house-collapse reports and questions about currently available features. The index also surfaces answered or moved threads, but not a stable data table. These are triage leads; a single thread does not establish a rule, and official patch notes or reproducible tests take priority.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 2026-09-12 查看时，讨论索引显示 273 个活跃主题；近期标题包括关系与恋爱、鲜饲料发白、草莓田睡后消失、市政厅附近停车后车辆不见、房屋坍塌，以及当前到底有哪些功能等问题。索引还会出现已回答或已移动的帖子，但不是稳定的数据表。这些只作为排查线索；单个帖子不能证明规则，官方补丁说明或可复现实测优先。

externalResources.title: Family and generations: assistance is planned, child play is not
externalResources.titleZh: 家庭与世代边界：可协助，但不能扮演子女
externalResources.description: In an August Steam moderator answer, children cannot become a playable next generation. The answer describes a future family role in which a spouse and children can assist with daily ranch duties; a follow-up comment also notes that children are not implemented in the current Early Access build. This is a family-systems boundary, not proof of a current marriage, child or inheritance loop.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 8 月 Steam 版主答复说明：子女不能成为可操作的下一代角色；答复把配偶和子女协助日常牧场事务描述为家庭系统方向。后续评论也指出当前抢先体验还没有子女功能。这是家庭系统边界，不代表当前已有结婚、孩子或继承循环。

externalResources.title: Window objective: a window wall is not a window
externalResources.titleZh: 窗户任务：窗墙不能代替窗户本体
externalResources.description: In an answered Steam building thread, the moderator clarifies that the quest checks the installed window object itself. Building a wall section with a window opening is a separate requirement and does not satisfy the window count; the same distinction applies to doorway walls versus the door object.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在一篇已回答的 Steam 建造讨论中，版主明确：任务检查的是实际安装的窗户本体。带窗开口的墙体是另一项要求，不能代替窗户数量；门墙与门本体也按同样逻辑分别计算。

externalResources.title: Animal seller purchase tab: purple-heart embargo
externalResources.titleZh: 动物商人购买页：紫心会暂时封锁商店
externalResources.description: In an answered Steam thread, moderator Jennoula confirms that purple hearts mean the NPC is upset and has embargoed their store. The same reply says gift preferences differ by NPC and relationship gain only applies to the first gift of the day. The author reports that plant-based gifts returned the hearts to red and restored access, but that recovery step is a player report rather than a universal item recipe.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在一篇已回答的 Steam 讨论中，版主 Jennoula 确认紫色心形表示 NPC 不满，并会暂时封锁商店。答复还说明每个 NPC 的喜好不同，每天只有第一份礼物会提升关系。发帖者随后报告用植物类礼物把心形变回红色并恢复购买页，但这个恢复步骤只是玩家实测，不是通用的固定礼物配方。

externalResources.title: Chicken starvation warning: check the water trough
externalResources.titleZh: 鸡显示挨饿：先检查水槽
externalResources.description: In a Steam thread about chickens showing as starving, moderator Jennoula advises hand-feeding as a short-term precaution, adding water to the coop trough and checking sickness plus the number of animals linked to the coop. The thread is useful for troubleshooting a warning, not proof of a species-wide death timer or a feed-consumption number.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在一篇“鸡显示挨饿”的 Steam 讨论中，版主 Jennoula 建议先手动喂食作为短期保险，把水加到鸡舍水槽，并检查生病状态以及鸡舍关联的动物数量。这适合排查警告，不足以证明所有鸡都有统一死亡倒计时或固定饲料消耗量。

externalResources.title: Passing out after midnight can advance an extra day
externalResources.titleZh: 午夜后昏倒可能额外跳过一天
externalResources.description: In an answered Steam thread, moderator Jennoula explains that if the clock has already passed midnight when the player sleeps or passes out, the day rolls forward again on wake-up (for example, day 12 becomes day 13 after midnight and day 14 after the sleep/pass-out). The moderator says the presentation is unclear and the behavior is flagged for review.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 在一篇已回答的 Steam 讨论中，版主 Jennoula 说明：如果睡觉或昏倒时已经过了午夜，醒来时日期还会再向前跳一天（例如第 12 天过午夜变第 13 天，睡觉/昏倒后醒来是第 14 天）。版主同时表示游戏提示不清晰，该行为已被标记复核。

externalResources.title: Independent SEO site: historical marketing only
externalResources.titleZh: 独立 SEO 站：仅作历史宣传审计
externalResources.description: The-ranchers.com labels itself independent but still says March 20, 2026, repeats pre-release auction, companion-app, mining, combat and family copy, and provides no current build or primary gameplay evidence. It is useful for catching search aliases only, not for current availability, prices, recipes, map markers or feature status.
externalResources.descriptionZh: the-ranchers.com 自称独立站，但仍写 2026 年 3 月 20 日发售，重复抢先体验前的拍卖、伴侣应用、采矿、战斗和家庭文案，也没有当前版本或一手玩法证据。它只适合发现搜索别名，不能用于当前可用性、价格、配方、地图标点或功能状态。

externalResources.title: Steam review signal snapshot
externalResources.titleZh: Steam 评测信号快照
externalResources.description: The September 13 Steam snapshot contains 50 collected reviews (33 positive, 17 negative) and topic counts led by driving (10), farming (8), building (7), content (7) and quests (6). The newest visible Sep 11 reviews still add negative sentiment about bug density, tutorial/dialogue clarity and driving, while early-September positive reviews frame the game as a promising Early Access project. Older samples still mention missing items, crops lost after passing out and building undo/save friction. These are triage signals, not mechanics or bug rates.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 9 月 13 日 Steam 快照包含 50 条已采集评测（33 条好评、17 条差评），主题计数主要集中在驾驶（10）、种田（8）、建造（7）、内容（7）和任务（6）。最新可见的 9 月 11 日评测仍集中反映 Bug 密度、教程/对话清晰度和驾驶体验；9 月初的好评则把它视为有潜力的抢先体验项目。更早样本仍提到物品不见、昏倒后作物丢失和建造撤销/存档不便。这些只是排查信号，不能当作玩法或 Bug 比例。

externalResources.title: Official FAQ: current systems and boundaries
externalResources.titleZh: 官方 FAQ：当前系统与内容边界
externalResources.description: The developer's September 2026 FAQ confirms current product-level boundaries for solo and four-player co-op, crop quality, seasonal farming, animal reproduction and sickness, veterinary care, housing, transport and older pre-release promises. Use it to reject stale wiki claims before adding a mechanic to the database; it does not provide exact rates, prices, recipes or coordinates.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 开发商 2026 年 9 月 FAQ 确认了单人和四人联机、作物品质、季节种植、动物繁殖与生病、兽医照料、住所和交通等当前产品级边界，也说明旧版宣传不能直接当作现状。在把机制加入数据库前先用它排除过时 Wiki 说法；它不提供精确概率、价格、配方或坐标。

externalResources.title: Community Wiki guide and database hub
externalResources.titleZh: 社区 Wiki 攻略与数据库总览
externalResources.description: A current fan wiki exposes guide, animal and item categories that are useful for finding missing player questions. Its pages mix Early Access, demo and older material; the homepage and release/platform page still carry pre-launch or unsupported platform and price copy, and its September 0.8.10.858 article adds claims that are not present in the cited official patch. Use it as an audit index, not a source of current numbers.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 一个持续更新的玩家 Wiki 提供攻略、动物和物品分类，适合发现本站遗漏的玩家问题。其页面混合抢先体验、Demo 和旧资料；首页与发售/平台页仍带有抢先体验前或未经证实的平台、价格和状态文案，9 月的 0.8.10.858 文章还加入了官方公告没有写出的说法。因此只能当覆盖面审计索引，不能直接当当前数值来源。

externalResources.title: Community item encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: 社区物品百科
externalResources.description: The July 28 item index exposes useful fields for tools, ore, fertilizer tiers, weapons and barn modules, but it explicitly mixes demo, alpha and Steam material. Its mining, dungeon, combat and auction wording is not a current 0.8.10.858 table; recipes and availability still need current-build evidence.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 这份 7 月 28 日物品索引能发现工具、矿石、肥料等级、武器和畜棚模块等字段，但它明确混合 Demo、Alpha 和 Steam 资料。页面里的采矿、地牢、战斗和拍卖文案不是当前 0.8.10.858 数据表；配方与可用性仍需当前版本证据。

externalResources.title: Community early-game walkthrough
externalResources.titleZh: 社区前期流程攻略
externalResources.description: This walkthrough is useful for auditing the questions new players ask about the tent, first tools, Cash-In, Gigi/Scott, the scarecrow and Victor's vehicle route. It mixes Early Access observations with older build references, so the site uses it for terminology and route gaps rather than current prices, distances or unlock guarantees.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 这篇流程攻略适合审查新玩家会问的帐篷、初始工具、Cash-In、Gigi/Scott、稻草人和 Victor 车辆路线。页面混合抢先体验观测与旧版本引用，因此本站只用它补术语和路线缺口，不把价格、距离或解锁条件当成当前保证。

externalResources.title: Into Indie Games launch walkthrough
externalResources.titleZh: Into Indie Games 发售日流程攻略
externalResources.description: An independent launch-day walkthrough covers the airport arrival, tent, southeast tools, Cash-In, Gigi and Scott, the scarecrow and Victor's old car. It is useful as a second wording check for the opening route, but its repair price and Cash-In warning are author-era observations without a current build marker.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 一篇独立媒体的发售日流程攻略，覆盖机场抵达、帐篷、东南方工具、Cash-In、Gigi 与 Scott、稻草人和 Victor 的旧车。它适合做前期路线的第二套措辞核对，但修车价格和 Cash-In 提示只是作者当时的观察，没有当前构建标记。

externalResources.title: Community animal encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: 社区动物百科
externalResources.description: A focused animal overview helps audit the categories players expect to find: coops, barns, feed, breeding and products. It explicitly says per-animal numbers are still to be added, and its pig, wool and processing claims have no current-build proof.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 一篇专门的动物总览可用于审查玩家会查的分类：鸡舍、畜棚、饲料、繁殖和产物。页面明确说每种动物的数字仍待补充，其中猪、羊毛和加工产物说法没有当前版本证据。

externalResources.title: Community farming encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: 社区种田百科
externalResources.description: A farming overview is useful for checking whether our crop page covers soil, seasons, greenhouses, automation and the sell-versus-process decision. It intentionally leaves exact crop names and values for Early Access verification, so it is a category checklist only.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 一篇种田总览可用于检查本站作物页是否覆盖土壤、季节、温室、自动化以及直接出售和加工之间的决策。页面明确把具体作物名称与数值留给抢先体验核对，因此这里只作分类清单。

externalResources.title: Community crafting encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: 社区制作百科
externalResources.description: The July 28 crafting guide gives the items database a useful navigation model: workbench, workshop, tools, machines and material flow. It also presents mining, smelting, combat, auction and powered-workshop progression without a single current-build boundary, so recipes, unlocks and upgrade costs remain local-build fields.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 这份 7 月 28 日制作攻略为物品数据库提供了工作台、工作坊、工具、机器和材料流转的导航框架，但还把采矿、冶炼、战斗、拍卖和 powered workshop 进度写在一起，没有统一当前构建边界，因此配方、解锁和升级成本仍以本地构建字段为准。

externalResources.title: Community quest encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: 社区任务百科
externalResources.description: The quest guide is useful for auditing progression-gate questions: villagers, vendors, workshops, blueprints and vehicle access. It is a route index, not proof of current coordinates or unlock conditions.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 任务攻略可用于审查进度门槛问题：村民、商店、工作坊、蓝图和车辆解锁。它只是路线索引，不能证明当前坐标或解锁条件。

externalResources.title: Legacy Fandom encyclopedia
externalResources.titleZh: Fandom 历史百科
externalResources.description: The old Fandom wiki has a small, pre-Early-Access encyclopedia with legacy shop, vehicle and animal-variant names. Its Farmer's Land and Wanglow Garage pages expose old locations, opening-hours patterns, vehicle aliases and shop-table shapes, but the landing page still describes the game as an unreleased 2023 title; those hours, prices and vehicle specs are historical, not 0.8.10.858 data.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 旧 Fandom Wiki 是一份规模较小的抢先体验前百科，保留了历史商店、车辆和动物变体名称。Farmer's Land 与 Wanglow Garage 页面还展示旧位置、营业时间模式、车辆别名和商店表结构，但首页仍把游戏写成计划于 2023 年发布；这些时间、价格和车辆规格只能当历史资料，不能当作 0.8.10.858 数据。

externalResources.title: Evidence-linked fan answers
externalResources.titleZh: 带证据链接的玩家答案
externalResources.description: This small fan guide publishes only a few answers with direct evidence, including the current co-op scope and an attributed dumpster route. It deliberately leaves recipes, crop values and animal-care numbers open for gameplay testing.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 这个小型玩家指南只发布少量带直接证据的答案，包括当前联机范围和有归属来源的翻垃圾路线；配方、作物数值和动物照料数据仍留给实测。

externalResources.title: Evidence-aware community wiki hub
externalResources.titleZh: 有证据边界的社区 Wiki 总览
externalResources.description: A separate fan hub records the Steam AppID, Early Access scope, review date and explicit gaps across three focused guides. It is useful for page structure and source boundaries, but it predates 0.8.10.858 and is not a live data authority.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 另一个玩家百科总览记录 Steam AppID、抢先体验范围、复核日期以及三篇攻略的明确数据缺口。它适合参考页面结构和来源边界，但早于 0.8.10.858，也不是当前数据权威。

externalResources.title: SteamDB metadata check
externalResources.titleZh: SteamDB 元数据校验
externalResources.description: SteamDB is useful for AppID, release, platform and package metadata, including a Steam Deck compatibility snapshot. It is a third-party mirror and cannot prove gameplay rules, recipes, coordinates or current feature availability.
externalResources.descriptionZh: SteamDB 可用于核对 AppID、发售、平台和包元数据，也能看到 Steam Deck 兼容性快照。它是第三方镜像，不能证明玩法规则、配方、坐标或当前功能可用性。

externalResources.title: Steam official support hub
externalResources.titleZh: Steam 官方技术支持入口
externalResources.description: Steam's official support page gathers the developer contact, current store requirements, discussion links and community-guide links for AppID 1501310. It is the right starting point for a technical report, but the linked guide cards and thread counts are dynamic and do not turn player posts into verified mechanics.
externalResources.descriptionZh: Steam 官方支持页集中列出 AppID 1501310 的开发者联系方式、当前商店配置、讨论入口和社区攻略入口。遇到技术问题应从这里开始，但攻略卡片和帖子数量会变化，玩家发帖不会因此变成已验证玩法。

externalResources.title: Reddit player-experience radar
externalResources.titleZh: Reddit 玩家体验雷达
externalResources.description: A Reddit discussion collects player impressions about the Early Access content boundary, sparse onboarding, awkward driving, confusing police/crime systems and mixed Steam Deck experiences. These are useful discovery signals, not reproducible mechanics or a representative review sample.
externalResources.descriptionZh: 一条 Reddit 讨论集中记录了玩家对抢先体验内容边界、教程不足、驾驶别扭、警察/犯罪系统困惑以及 Steam Deck 体验差异的感受。它适合发现问题，不是可复现的玩法证据，也不代表整体评测样本。

externalResources.title: Publisher page: identity and marketing boundary
externalResources.titleZh: 发行商页面：身份与宣传边界
externalResources.description: Trophy Games' publisher page confirms the broad product identity and links official media, but it is a marketing page without a current build marker, recipe table, coordinate list or feature-status changelog. Use it for ownership and naming checks only.
externalResources.descriptionZh: Trophy Games 的发行商页面可核对产品身份和官方媒体入口，但它是没有当前构建标记的宣传页，不提供配方表、坐标表或功能状态变更记录。这里只用于核对归属与名称。

externalResources.title: GamePressure database: mixed-era overview
externalResources.titleZh: GamePressure 数据库：混合版本概览
externalResources.description: GamePressure now has a The Ranchers database page with an Early Access label and a generated review summary, but its overview still repeats pre-release systems such as fishing, hunting, mines, combat and a companion app, and even names WildPixel Games as the developer. It is useful for catching search aliases and misinformation, not for current mechanics or requirements.
externalResources.descriptionZh: GamePressure 现在有《The Ranchers》数据库页，带有抢先体验标签和自动生成的评测摘要，但正文仍重复钓鱼、狩猎、矿洞、战斗和伴侣应用等发售前系统，甚至把开发商写成 WildPixel Games。它只适合发现搜索别名和错误信息，不能作为当前玩法或配置来源。

externalResources.title: Chinese portal pages: historical only
externalResources.titleZh: 中文门户资料：仅作历史审计
externalResources.description: Chinese portal coverage is still not a current encyclopedia: the GamerSky main page provides Chinese aliases, developer, platform and a July 2026 listing, but its system requirements are legacy; the GamerSky handbook topic has no entries, while 游侠, 3DM and a recent 九游 article repeat pre-release claims such as online auctions, companion apps, marriage/family, mines and combat while mixing in advertising copy. The Chinese Steam store snapshot also retains old Coming Soon and feature copy even though current English announcements are live EA. A 小黑盒 hit is only a 2022 preview roundup, and Baidu/NGA searches did not surface a current data table. These pages help find Chinese search aliases, not current-build data.

sources.titleZh: 每日订单攻略保留物品、期限与奖励待核验
sources.summary: The evidence-aware community guide updated Aug 13 asks players to read the live order screen and record the requested item, deadline, delivery details and reward. It deliberately avoids fixed order values because availability and terms can change.
sources.summaryZh: 这个有证据边界的社区攻略于 8 月 13 日更新，要求玩家按当前订单界面记录物品、期限、交付信息和奖励；由于可用性和条件会变化，页面刻意不写固定订单金额。
sources.why: It adds a practical task-and-economy lookup path without turning a changing request board into a stale reward table.
sources.whyZh: 它补充了任务与经济的实际查找路径，同时避免把会变化的订单板误做成过时的固定奖励表。
sources.risk: The page is a community planning guide, not an official order dump, and it does not state a current patch. Item names, deadlines and rewards still need a screenshot or live-build record before entering the database.
sources.riskZh: 页面是社区规划攻略，不是官方订单数据表，也没有标明当前补丁。物品名称、期限和奖励仍需截图或当前版本记录后才能进入数据库。
